messages.Energie-DP liefert Wh → in kWh umrechnen: Energy data point provides Wh → convert to kWh
messages.Aktivieren, wenn der kumulierte Ladeener: Enable this when the cumulative charging-energy data point provides Wh. NexoWatt divides the value by 1000 and processes it internally as kWh.

text.Ladebedarf / Ladebereit (lesen, optional: Charge demand / ready to charge (read-only, optional)
text.Legacy: Fahrzeug/Ladevorgang aktiv (nur: Legacy: vehicle/charging session active (read-only, not a reservation source)
text.Mehrere Werte mit Komma, Semikolon oder: Separate multiple values with commas, semicolons or line breaks. *Text* allows substring matches.
text.Priorität: reale Leistung → expliziter L: Priority: actual power → explicit charge demand → vehicle connection → normalised status. “Available” alone does not reserve charging power.
text.Fahrzeug/Ladevorgang aktiv (lesen, optio: Vehicle/charging session active (read-only, optional) · legacy, not a reservation source
text.NVP-Zielmitte/Messtoleranz: wird aus der: Grid-point target/tolerance: inherited from the active Storage or Storage Farm app
text.MultiUse besitzt keine eigene NVP-Regelu: MultiUse has no separate grid-point controller. Target and measurement tolerance are always inherited directly from the active Storage or Storage Farm app.
text.Eigene Zielmitte und Messtoleranz der Fa: Dedicated target and measurement tolerance for the storage farm. Outside the tolerance, the shared fast farm controller regulates directly to the target. MultiUse has no second grid-point controller.
text.Aktiviert Tarif-, Reserve- und sonstige: Enables tariff, reserve and other grid-charging paths. During an active §14a command, only this grid charging is limited. PV/self-consumption charging and battery discharge remain unaffected. Without the checkbox, the battery charges only from local generation.
text.E3/DC-Unterfreigabe: Netzladen als GRID_: E3/DC sub-permission: write grid charging as GRID_CHARGE
text.Tarif-, Reserve- und sonstige Netzladean: Enable tariff, reserve and other grid-charging requests for the storage farm. During an active §14a command, only the grid-charging share is limited; PV charging and discharge remain available.
text.Konfiguration für netzseitige Leistungsb: Configuration for grid-side power limitation of controllable consumers. Assigned charging points, active heating/cooling devices, heating rods and storage systems with grid charging enabled are linked automatically. This is a grid-protection function and is not operated by end customers.
text.Die §14a-Basis beträgt mindestens 4.200: The §14a base is at least 4,200 W. Larger heating/cooling groups are calculated using the configured special formula.
text.Nur für weitere Verbraucher, die keinem: Only for additional consumers not assigned to a NexoWatt specialist module. Charging points, active heat pumps/cooling devices, heating rods and storage systems with grid charging enabled are added automatically to the central §14a cap calculation.
text.Tipp: Für einen zusätzlichen manuellen V: Tip: for an additional manual consumer, connect either a power setpoint (W) or Enable/Disable. If both are configured, the setpoint takes precedence. Automatically linked specialist modules are controlled exclusively through their own robust controller.
text.Keine zusätzlichen manuellen Verbraucher: No additional manual consumers configured. Assigned charging points, active heating/cooling devices, heating rods and storage systems with grid charging enabled are linked automatically.

operatingStrategies.fallback.standardAut: Fall back to standard automatic mode
